title: Cross-stitch inclusive bouquet
subtitle: A bouquet of flowers in six pride rainbow colours on 14-count white Aida
excerpt: A tied bouquet of six flowers, each in a different colour from the rainbow sequence, on 14-count white Aida. The design is approximately 80 by 100 stitches and finishes at around 14 by 18 cm. Each flower type uses a different stitch approach (cross-stitch fill, French knot centres, and back-stitch stem and leaf detail), making it a good sampler project for building cross-stitch skills.
sourceNotes: Original design. The six-flower rainbow bouquet format combines florals and pride symbolism into a single decorative piece. Combining multiple flower types in a single bouquet design is a standard UK cross-stitch format.

glossaryTerms.definition: A loop stitch that forms a single petal or leaf shape. The thread is looped and held down by a tiny catch stitch at the tip of the loop, creating a detached oval shape. Six or eight lazy daisies radiating from a central point make a simple flower.

content.text: Each flower in the bouquet represents one stripe of the rainbow flag and uses a different technique: the red poppy uses cross-stitch fill, the orange flower uses
petals. Yellow is French knots. Green leaves are back-stitch. Blue is cross-stitch fill, and violet is cross-stitch fill. A short back-stitch ribbon ties the base.

items.label: Thread
items.value: DMC 321 (red), 741 (orange), 972 (yellow), 703 (green), 996 (blue), 553 (violet), 319 (dark green), 368 (light green), 3782 (mocha ribbon), 310 (black) — for French knot centres

content.text: Work the cross-stitch fill flowers first.
Stitch the red poppy (321), blue cornflower (996), and violet flower (553) as full cross-stitch fills from the chart. These are the largest elements and define the bouquet layout.
Add the orange lazy daisy flower.
Work six lazy daisy petals in 741 radiating from a central hole. Add a French knot centre in 310.
Work the yellow French knot cluster.
A cluster of twelve to fifteen French knots in 972 forms the yellow buttercup mass. Scatter loosely for a natural flower-head shape.
Stitch the green leaf and stem structure.
Work all stems in back-stitch in 319. Fill the leaves in 368 cross-stitch with a 319 midrib back-stitch line on each.
Work the ribbon bow and gathered stem base in back-stitch using 3782. The bow loop is outlined in one strand of back-stitch.
Frame in an 18 × 22 cm rectangular frame or display in a 20 cm round hoop. The white Aida background keeps the design clean and lets all six rainbow colours read clearly.
